# Nat depth controls

The two originals are byte-identical to the pin listed in NOTICE. `controls`
varies a single Nat literal pattern and uses Bool or U32 results to separate
matching depth from leaf representation. `near` applies the 59n matcher below,
at and above the matching value; these are authored derivatives, not successful
executions of either original. All guards remain unchanged.
